# v0.1.18

## 中文

- 自动巡检新增「巡检范围」，可选全量或抽检；选择抽检时直接沿用上方「抽检」行填写的数量与比例，无需重复配置，该行会高亮标记联动关系。
- 抽检模式下的自动处置只作用于本轮实际探测到的账号，不会影响未被抽中的账号。
- 修复自动巡检状态文字被截断、显示不全的问题，空间不足时状态会自动占满整行完整显示。
- 修复英文界面下自动巡检控件标签被省略号截断的问题。
- 优化手机端自动巡检控件排布，六个控件以两列显示，保存按钮独占一行。

## English

- Scheduled inspection now has a Scope option (Full or Sample). Sample reuses the count and percent from the Sample row above instead of asking for them twice, and that row is highlighted while the two are linked.
- In Sample scope, automatic actions only apply to accounts actually probed in that run, leaving unsampled accounts untouched.
- Fixed the scheduled inspection status text being truncated and unreadable at many window widths; it now takes a full row when space is tight.
- Fixed schedule control labels being truncated with ellipses in the English UI.
- Improved the mobile schedule layout: six controls in two columns, with the save button on its own row.
